watches.name: South Beach - Noir - SS
watches.description: The South Beach's design honors a distinctive, rectangular case shape (aka "Tank") that was born during the Age of Art Deco and endures to this day. A tribute to geometric shapes and patterns, the vertical troughs of the case mimic many of the façades of the historic neighborhood’s iconic structures with their concave, convex and angular details. Timeless sophistication meets the glamour of Miami after dark. Featuring a high-gloss black dial, crisp white, Art Deco numerals and elegant gilt accents, the South Beach – Noir in stainless steel captures the understated elegance of the Age. A refined statement of classic style with a contemporary edge. This watch is paired with a black alligator strap that is not too stiff, yet feels incredibly durable. A milanese/mesh bracelet is also included with the watch should you wish to make it fully water resistant and/or a bit more sporty. **Customers in the European Union are responsible for all import duties and taxes.

watches.name: Lexington – Havana - S
watches.description: Identical to the Lexington - Havana, the Havana - S version features highly legible matte hands that give the watch a slightly more sporty feel. The watch still features an indulgent cacao-colored dial reminiscent of a fine, Cuban cigar. Paired with a navy blue Nubuck strap by Delugs, the full package plays on a classic color combination that is both unique and stylish. Designed to transport you back to a time when Havana was the destination for well-heeled Americans looking for relief from the restrictive laws of Prohibition. The brown is dark, going from a luscious chocolate to an inky espresso depending on the light. Its warmth complements the circular brushed copper inset in a way that would have been lost had it been black. – The Time Bum

watches.name: South Beach - Riptide
watches.description: The South Beach's design honors a distinctive, rectangular case shape (aka "Tank") that was born during the Age of Art Deco and endures to this day. A tribute to geometric shapes and patterns, the vertical troughs of the case mimic many of the façades of the historic neighborhood’s iconic structures with their concave, convex and angular details. Named to honor the infamous Riptide Club that opened in 1937 and quickly became known as a place where mobsters mixed with film stars, and politicians with business tycoons. The South Beach - Riptide's color palette is restrained and dignified. Evoking the scene of a smokey, Jazz filled nightclub, it features a grey dial with a reflective metallic hour track. The minute and seconds track is colored with a dark teal, while the sub-dial stands out in mix of ivory and beige. For a more modern and refined look, this watch is paired with a light beige sailcloth strap that is durable and water resistant, perfect from going from the beach to the club. For the traditionalist, the watch also comes with a milanese/mesh bracelet and two straps in black are available for purchase: textured rubber (shown in pictures and Saffiano leather. **Customers in the European Union are responsible for all import duties and taxes.

watches.name: South Beach - Surf Club
watches.description: The South Beach's design honors a distinctive, rectangular case shape (aka "Tank") that was born during the Age of Art Deco and endures to this day. A tribute to geometric shapes and patterns, the vertical troughs of the case mimic many of the façades of the historic neighborhood’s iconic structures with their concave, convex and angular details. Named to honor the "original" Surf Club that was built by tire tycoon Harvey Firestone in 1930 and still operating today at 9011 Collins Ave. It quickly became the playground for the rich and famous. It was notorious for having liquor on the beach during Prohibition, a massive swimming pool adorned with cabanas and a variety of themed galas that featured everything from live elephants to tables made entirely of ice. It was over-the-top extravagance that set the stage for what South Beach and Miami Beach would become in the years that followed. The South Beach - Surf Club is for people who love bold and vibrant colors. This “fun in the sun” dial features a clean, silvery/white dial with touches of yellow, teal and pink; colors synonymous with South Beach and tropical Deco. Keeping with the pool party vibe, this watch is paired with a textured, white rubber strap that is soft, comfortable and fully water resistant. A milanese/mesh bracelet is also included with the watch and a variety of other colorful straps are available in the shop. **Customers in the European Union are responsible for all import duties and taxes.

watches.name: Stainless Steel Bracelet
watches.description: Although many would call our timepieces "dress watches", we've always believed them to be the perfect hybrid between a dress watch and a sport watch, especially given the skin-diver inspired structure of the mid-case. Now, there's a bracelet that makes our watches even sportier. Made of robust, stainless steel, this bracelet has a minimalist design that won't distract from the design of the watch. At 20mm in width, this fully brushed finish bracelet is compatible with both the Eastern and the Lexington. It features a butterfly deployment clasp and a quick release system, so that you can easily change between bracelet and leather strap. With a total length of 7.32 inches or 18.6 cm, it can accommodate the largest of wrists. Or remove a few links, so that it fits a small wrists.

watches.name: Eastern – Pacific (Gold Bezel)
watches.description: Housed in a striking two-tone case, the dial of the Eastern – Pacific (Gold) is dominated by two complementary shades of blue. A dark navy base reminds us of the Pacific Ocean’s deep waters, while the chapter ring’s playful baby blue is inspired by the terracotta tiles that make up the façade of the Eastern Columbia Building. Polished, golden Art Deco numerals and circular, stepped hour markers bring a subtle touch of glamor to an otherwise minimalist dial. For a touch of sportiness, twelve baton hour markers have been applied in a sector-style layout, using BGW9 Grade A, Swiss Super - Luminova®. Playful, sporty, dressy - this watch does it all.

watches.description: Inspired by the sand, sea and sky of a Montauk, N.Y. dawn. The unique, pastel color of this dial hovers somewhere between yellow and orange. It’s the choice for people who love summer vibes, no matter what season it is.

watches.name: Lexington – Morocco
watches.description: A vibrant, sky-blue dial which is juxtaposed with a brushed, copper chapter ring to echo the rich browns of the Moroccan marble found in the lobby of the Chrysler Building. The Morocco is presented on a brown, nubuck leather strap that pairs perfectly with the brown hues of copper and gives this watch a slightly vintage look and feel. It’s also our most popular model. Of the variations available (there are four), the standout is by far the combination of blue dial with a copper hour ring. It has all the glamour of an Art Deco dress watch without actually being a dress watch per se. – Oracle Time

watches.name: Lexington – Cloud Club
watches.description: Named after the infamous, private, men-only club that was perched atop the highest floors of the Chrysler Building, this watch features a crisp, sky-blue dial and a brushed, silver chapter ring. The [Cloud Club] Lexington dial is immediately arresting in its courageous complexity. The metallic-silver hour ring focuses attention, but the dominance of deep matte blue settles the eye. – Off The Cuff **Customers in the European Union are responsible for all import duties and taxes.
